items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: You know Phil Woods had a great story about that.

ctx.x: Exactly. Yes is the most important word I think a musician can have in their vocabulary because you never know. And though you may be tempted to go, like the thing with Christopher, I almost went oh man there’s no rehearsal bread there’s nothing. I’m so happy I said yeah I’ll do it.
You know Phil Woods had a great story about that. He opted just to get the money for the Billy Joel thing with “Just the Way You Are.”
